newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne board rejects Invacare bid.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne board rejects Invacare bid.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc Friday said its board voted unanimously to recommend that shareholders reject the unsolicited tender offer by Invacare Corp.

"This is the second time in eight days that our board has met to consider an Invacare offer to acquire the company. The board reiterated that the company is not for sale," said Craig Reynolds, president and chief executive officer.
Healthdyne said its board considered several factors, including the opinion of adviser Cowen & Co that the $13.00 per share price offered by Invacare is grossly inadequate.
